effective_date_basis: Section 7 expressly sets September 30, 1997 as the effective date, distinct from signing September 29.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Section 3 revokes five establishing orders whose committees had already terminated or completed their work. EO12987,13032,12890,12921,12970 appear as amendments and are not independently revoked as whole orders. Section 4 separately supersedes EO12974.
leads: Locate actual earlier committee completion and termination.
Review independent provisions of amendment instruments before inferring whole-order cessation.

legal_effect: Research lead only. Express revocation/supersession does not establish first substantive cessation, extinguish saved effects or change any provisional status.
quoted_clause:
Sec. 3. The following Executive orders which established committees that
have terminated and whose work is completed, are revoked:
(a) Executive Order 12891, establishing the Advisory Committee on Human
Radiation Experiments;
(b) Executive Order 12964, as amended by Executive Orders 12987 and
13032, establishing the Commission on United States-Pacific Trade and In-
vestment Policy;
(c) Executive Order 12946, establishing the President’s Advisory Board
on Arms Proliferation Policy;
(d) Executive Order 12864, as amended by Executive Orders 12890, 12921,
and 12970, establishing the United States Advisory Council on the National
Information Infrastructure; and
(e) Executive Order 13015, establishing the White House Commission on
Aviation Safety and Security.
